entries.title: Underwater glue breakthrough boosts repair efficiency and cuts carbon #shorts #glue #repairing
entries.summary: Japanese scientists have developed the strongest underwater adhesive by analyzing barnacle proteins, known for their natural ability to stick to rocks for millions of years.
